title: Isandro and the Parish
author: Cyrus Marchetti
blurb: August Okonkwo, a night-shift dispatcher for a taxi company, has quietly solved three deaths the police called accidents. Then the town's beloved founder is exhumed and the coffin is empty — and she is pulled straight into the middle of it. Now she must find the witness everyone swears is dead, and time is already running out.
style: crisp modern voice, short chapters, propulsive momentum
